column1: # AoE2 unit slug -> upgrade-line id -> rank within that line. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the
# hand-curated `line`/`lineRank` fields of `src/data/unit-stats.json` (used by the site to group a
# unit with its upgrades, e.g. Man-at-Arms under "militia-line" rank 2). Columns: slug<TAB>line<TAB>lineRank
# Not derivable from the aalises `units.csv` source (that CSV has no upgrade-line concept) —
# extracted 2026-07-10 from the previously committed `src/data/unit-stats.json`'s own `line`/
# `lineRank` fields (the JS generator `scripts/build-units.mjs` carried these forward from each
# prior run's output rather than tracking them in a standalone file; this table makes that
# hand-authored data reviewable in git diffs instead of buried in generated JSON). Every slug in
# `refdata::canonical_units::CANONICAL_UNITS` must have a row here — the loader fails loud
# (`RefdataError::MissingUnitLine`) on any gap rather than defaulting to a fabricated line/rank.
# `lineRank` starting above 1 (e.g. `fire-ship-line` at 2) means rank 1 of that line belongs to a
# unit outside this table's CANONICAL_UNITS scope (e.g. a civ-specific Fire Galley variant) — not a
# gap, just this table's own numbering carried forward as-is from the source JSON.
